call.sequence_note: SAME CONVERSATION, SECOND RECORDING. This is the direct continuation of the call captured in drive_file_id 18wH1x6FKtaOB7wziGzRi4dDry4gMS9f2 (call_id 2026-07-14_joanna-rattan_michael-brideau), which cut off mid-sentence during the first pillar after the rep's connection froze. The two recordings were created 36 minutes apart and this one opens with the rep re-orienting himself — 'what were we talking about... we're talking about onboarding... training mobility three pillars' — and resumes at exactly the point the previous file stopped. Discovery, baseline, goals and past attempts all live in the first recording; only the presentation, the price and the outcome are here. These are one call across two files with two different dates and must not be counted twice.

Refuses surgery on principle. On this recording she added a considered question about whether fasting is physiologically appropriate for women, and described a cousin who water-fasted for 40 days and had to be refed on juices.

No payment, no payment link, no plan quoted, no follow-up date and no next step agreed

Counter-evidence: she rated the coaching a solid 10 out of 10, confirmed it was the right thing at the right time, and committed to returning — 'I will work towards this goal. So we'll have this conversation again. You'll see me. It's not the last time you see me.'
Counter-evidence: her fallback is to keep following the free content — 'In the meantime, I'll just stick with his videos'
Scored 0.85 rather than higher because the intent to return was specific and volunteered; this is a genuine future re-open rather than a polite exit.
outcome.next_step: None agreed. Prospect to make contact when she can fund it; rep left an open door with no date and no plan.

notable.note: The prospect asked one of the best questions in the batch — whether intermittent fasting is physiologically appropriate for women, having read that it may not be — and received an answer built entirely on what the rep had observed among Trevor's female clients, with no reference to evidence or clinical input. She also raised a trust objection with a concrete history behind it, a paid in-person coach and nutritionist in Europe who produced no results, and the playbook contains a scripted move for precisely that situation which was not used; the rep replied 'They have to try it' and moved on. Commercially the call was handled decently and honestly: the hesitation was detected, named, decomposed and resolved, the money objection was isolated cleanly, and when the answer was a genuine no the rep took it without pressure. But he twice implied that other options existed and never quoted a single one, so the prospect left without knowing whether any structure could have worked. Worth noting alongside the internal calls from the same week: the rep repeatedly loses his thread here and remarks on it — 'I'm 33 and already have trouble with memory' and 'memory has actually been interesting for me the last little bit. No, I'm serious.'
